Title: Mobile Apps: Supporting IPv6 and the Apple submission process

Body.Content: Apple announced that all apps submitted to the iOS App Store for review must support IPv6-only networks. Your app submissions will likely work just fine as long as you're not embedding IPv4 addresses or using IPv4-specific communication methods in your apps. For more information, keep reading in the blog post.
